Ordinary kriging of residuals onto new locations (the correction surface)

Source: R/spatial_bias_reduction.R
residual_krige.Rd

Ordinary kriging of residuals onto new locations (the correction surface)

Usage

residual_krige(
  points,
  newdata,
  resid = "resid",
  model,
  aoa = NULL,
  aoa_thresh = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

points

An sf point layer carrying a residual column.

newdata

Where to predict: an sf point layer, or a terra SpatRaster template (non-NA cell centres are used and a raster is returned). Keep raster templates coarse - kriging every cell of a fine grid is expensive.

resid

Name of the residual column (default "resid").

model

A fitted variogram model (e.g. residual_variogram()$model).

aoa

Area-of-applicability restricting where the correction is produced: a SpatRaster dissimilarity-index surface (in-AOA where di <= aoa_thresh) or an sf/SpatVector polygon (see restrict_to_aoa). NULL predicts everywhere in newdata.

aoa_thresh

In-domain DI threshold for a raster aoa (default 1).

...

Passed to krige (e.g. nmax).

Value

newdata with the kriged correction (var1.pred) and variance (var1.var); a SpatRaster of both when newdata is a raster. Locations outside aoa are dropped (points) or NA (raster).
